applies_to: iSMA CONTROLLI iSMA-B-VAV14-IP VAV controllers running the factory VAV application (manual V1.4.0).
summary: The iSMA-B-VAV14-IP is a BACnet IP VAV controller with a built-in pressure sensor and damper actuator. Its fixed default application exposes temperature and airflow setpoints per occupancy state, occupancy and HVAC mode commands, network inputs for room, duct and outdoor temperature and CO2, calculated airflow and damper position, reheat, perimeter and fan outputs, and balancing commands. Each object also has a Modbus register.
notes: Units are printed as metric / imperial pairs (for example L/s / cfm); BO 2 Units selects metric or imperial when BV 12 allows BACnet configuration.
Network inputs (AV 10, 18, 19, 40) default to -327, which means no value; the selectors MV 23-25 choose panel, input or network as the source.
Many objects are linked to a Control Point room panel object (named in the manual); those panel-display objects (BO 16, 17, 55, 56, MV 0, 3-5) are for the panel.
A second manual page, "List of Variables in Application", describes the same application objects and is not repeated here.

source.title: iSMA-B-VAV14-IP User Manual V1.4.0 - BACnet Objects/Modbus Registers

integration.summary: Write the occupancy mode (MV 2) and HVAC mode (MV 1), adjust the occupied heating and cooling setpoints (AV 0, AV 1) if needed, and read space temperature, effective setpoints, actual airflow, damper position and the HVAC and occupancy status. If the room sensor is on the BMS, write AV 10 and set MV 23 to network.

minimum_points.name: HVACMode
minimum_points.why: HVAC mode: 1 auto, 2 heat, 4 cool, 7 off ...

integration.enable: MV 2 OccupancyMode and MV 1 HVACMode are the BMS commands; BV 12 must be false (BACnet) for the configuration to come from BACnet instead of the DIP switches.
integration.remote_sensors: Room temperature (AV 10), discharge temperature (AV 18), outdoor temperature (AV 19), CO2 (AV 40) and setpoint offset (AV 41) can come from the network; MV 23-25 select the source.
setup: BV 12 DeviceConfigurationSource: false = BACnet, true = DIP switch.
Set the K-factor (AV 61) and airflow limits (AV 11-17) at commissioning; BV 13 zeroes the pressure sensor with no airflow.
gotchas: Network inputs read -327 when no value has been written.
Test commands MV 7-10 (damper, fan, reheater, perimeter) override normal control; set them back to 1 (Auto).
